summary: Validated iter54 (P09 Smart Autopause) end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest PASS — 5 unit (mock pipeline: disabled, below_threshold, above_threshold trigger, below_min_events, count_fallback) + 5 E2E HTTP (GET config returns 5 new keys, PUT persists 25/30, PUT clamps 200→100/-5→1/999→60, PUT toggles enabled false→true, /api/health 200). Frontend: ShadowAutopauseSection renders correctly in Admin → Motor IA with all data-testids (section, toggle, 4 num inputs, 'Cómo funciona' yellow box). Toggle disable dims grid to opacity 0.45, enable restores 1.0. Edit threshold→Save button appears (dirty=true)→click→toast 'Configuración guardada'→reload→value 25 persisted. 0 console errors. 1 critical typo bug found and fixed (see RCA).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED — onSave={save} referenced an undefined identifier; would throw ReferenceError on every render of the Motor IA tab and crash the entire admin AI tab. Renamed to onSave={handleSave}.

action_items: (NONE — fix already applied) Verify the change at line 367 of ModelConfigTab.jsx is preserved in next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_eval_config.py _validate(): clamps via int() conversion drops floats silently; if frontend ever sends 25.7 it becomes 25 with no warning — acceptable but worth documenting.

ai_eval_routes.py PUT /config: AiEvalConfigPatch declares Optional[int] without Field(ge=,le=) — server-side clamping in _validate is the only line of defense. Adding Pydantic constraints would return 422 on bad input instead of silent clamp; current behaviour is intentionally lenient (E1's choice) but should be documented.

ModelConfigTab.jsx file is now ~940 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting ShadowAutopauseSection + ScheduleSection + PauseBanner into separate files under /components/admin/model-config/.

ShadowAutopauseSection: numeric onChange already clamps client-side, but if user types '0' for shadow_threshold_pct (min=1) the value flips to 1 silently with no UX feedback. Consider showing a helper-text warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter54 added P09 smart autopause for AI worker. Backend tests in test_iter54_smart_autopause.py (mock unit) + test_iter54_api_e2e.py (live HTTP). UI lives in ModelConfigTab.jsx ShadowAutopauseSection. Spanish UI: tabs are 'Consumo de tokens / Reporte de rutas / Configuración de costos / Motor IA'. Login flow: dev@me.mx → / (dashboard) → /admin → click 'Motor IA' tab → scroll past Schedule section.
rca of the issue: BUG: Line 367 of ModelConfigTab.jsx had `<ShadowAutopauseSection ... onSave={save} />` referencing undeclared identifier `save`. Repro: open /admin → Motor IA tab → React would attempt to evaluate the JSX expression and throw `ReferenceError: save is not defined`, crashing the ModelConfigTab subtree and triggering ErrorBoundary fallback (which would hide the entire Admin IA module). Mitigation applied: renamed to `onSave={handleSave}` (line 87 declares the correct handler). Verified via Playwright — section now mounts, edit/save/reload cycle works, toast appears, value persists 25 across reload.
